description: Zahidjee Textile Mills Limited is a composite textile unit engaged in spinning, weaving, processing and home textiles, and in exporting those products; the company describes itself as having entered its 35th year. It spins 100% cotton, polyester-cotton, CVC and polyester yarns in 6 to 40 counts, weaves pocketing, sheeting, herringbone and stripe satin fabrics, and finishes and stitches bed linen and institutional textiles for healthcare, hospitality, cruise-line, laundry and tourism customers.
headOffice: 131-A, Street P, Upper Mall Scheme, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: zahidjee.com.pk — about, yarn products, fabric products, finished products, board of directors and contact pages (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Yarn
products.summary: 100% cotton, 52/48 and 65/35 PC, 60/40 CVC and 100% polyester yarns in 6 to 40 counts, carded and combed, including slub, doubled, spandex and laiqra specialities for weaving and knitting.

products.name: Fabric
products.summary: Woven fabric in 100% cotton, PC, CVC and polyester at T-100 to T-200 constructions — pocketing, sheeting, herringbone and stripe satin — bleached, dyed or printed.

products.name: Home textile and institutional linen
products.summary: Sheets, draw sheets, pillowcases, knitted sheets, patient gowns and table cloth, finished bleached, dyed or printed and packed for healthcare, hospitality, institutional, cruise-line, laundry and tourism customers.
